headlines.title: European wildfires force new evacuations
headlines.description: Thousands more are evacuated from historic wildfires in France, Spain, and Italy. Firefighters are in an all-out battle to stop them, and the weather is not helping. NBC News’ Raf Sanchez is near the front lines in France.

headlines.title: Watch President Trump's full tribute to Sen. Lindsey Graham
headlines.description: Watch President Trump's full tribute to Sen. Lindsey Graham during the funeral service at Washington National Cathedral. The president recalled their past working together and previous rivalry running against each other in 2016.

headlines.title: Francesca Hong avoids attacks as Wisconsin Democrats meet for an amicable governor debate
headlines.description: The five Democratic candidates for governor in Wisconsin almost entirely refrained from lobbing attacks at one another during their only debate Tuesday night, even as the volatile race enters its final two weeks.

headlines.title: Torrential rain pummels the Northeast
headlines.description: Tens of millions in the Northeast are facing torrential downpours from powerful, slow-moving storms. This as the upper Midwest cleans up from multiple tornadoes there. NBC News’ Maggie Vespa reports from Wisconsin.

headlines.title: Powerful earthquake in Japan causes widespread damage
headlines.description: A 6.8 earthquake struck the southern Japanese island of Kyushu leaving dozens injured and causing extensive damage. First responders are now racing to save lives as authorities warn the public to remain vigilant. NBC News’ Matt Bradley has more.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: At least 13 killed in Japan earthquake as rescuers race to find others trapped in rubble
headlines.description: At least 13 people have been killed in southwestern Japan after a magnitude-7.1 earthquake, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said Wednesday, as rescuers searched for survivors of collapses at a shopping mall and a paper mill.

headlines.title: James Comey legal team argues DOJ’s seashells case erodes ‘bedrock’ principles
headlines.description: It’s the second time the Trump administration has found a way to criminally charge the former FBI director, whom Trump has targeted for years.

headlines.title: Francesca Hong avoids attacks as Wisconsin Democrats meet for an amicable governor debate
headlines.description: The five Democratic candidates for governor in Wisconsin almost entirely refrained from lobbing attacks at one another during their only debate Tuesday night, even as the volatile race enters its final two weeks.

headlines.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to overturn $83.3 million award in E. Jean Carroll defamation case
headlines.description: Lawyers for President Donald Trump argued that he had immunity for statements made while president.

headlines.title: South Dakota Gov. Larry Rhoden fends off challenger in GOP primary runoff
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Rhoden, who replaced Kristi Noem last year, defeated businessman Toby Doeden to win the Republican nomination for governor.

headlines.title: Two Democrats advance to a runoff in the Georgia special election to succeed late Rep. David Scott
headlines.description: Scott’s daughter Marcye Scott and fellow Democrat Everton Blair finished atop a five-candidate field, but no one got majority support, triggering the runoff, NBC News projects.
